dropped.finding: The public `BLOCKING_SEVERITIES` env var and the public `ReceiverConfig.blocking_severities` dataclass field are removed entirely (unversioned config-compat removal). An operator who currently sets `BLOCKING_SEVERITIES` in the review-bot environment will have that value silently ignored after this change; `ReceiverConfig.from_env()` no longer parses it and the dataclass no longer carries the attribute, so any external code reading `cfg.blocking_severities` will raise AttributeError.
scenarios: An operator with `BLOCKING_SEVERITIES=critical,high,medium` set in their review-bot deployment environment silently loses that override after upgrade
